detail.body:
Bumps [tokenizers](https://github.com/huggingface/tokenizers) from 0.21 to 0.23.3.
Release notes

Sourced from tokenizers's releases.

Release v0.23.3 (python only)

Release v0.23.3

Python package release, other packages are unchanged

:rotating_light: Fixs a breaking change introduced in v0.23.1

What's changed

Patch for the python package with three fixes:

  • Loosen the huggingface_hub requirements to allow huggingface_hub v2 huggingface/tokenizers#2486 - Unblocks transformers installs
  • Fix type hints not resolving for pyright: huggingface/tokenizers#2456
  • Fix a breaking change from 0.23.1 regarding truncation and overflowing: huggingface/tokenizers#2091

Full Changelog: https://github.com/huggingface/tokenizers/compare/v0.23.2...v0.23.3

v0.23.2

This is the last v0 release, we are moving to v1!!

More details coming soon 👀

What's Changed

  • Update daachorse from 1.0.1 to 3.0.0 by @​musicinmybrain in huggingface/tokenizers#2050
  • Ci test fixes by @​sebpop in huggingface/tokenizers#2079
  • Avoid full vocab clone in get_vocab_size() by @​eunseo9311 in huggingface/tokenizers#2074
  • ci: pin benchmark jobs to a larger dedicated runner by @​ArthurZucker in huggingface/tokenizers#2084
  • ci: target benchmark runners by group, not nonexistent label by @​ArthurZucker in huggingface/tokenizers#2090
  • Bindings: acquire model read-lock once per call instead of per pre-token by @​sebpop in huggingface/tokenizers#2072
  • ci: split audit in a separate job by @​SBrandeis in huggingface/tokenizers#2103
  • ci: install libcairo on benchmark runners by @​SBrandeis in huggingface/tokenizers#2100
  • feat(ci): enable npm's trusted publisher for releases by @​McPatate in huggingface/tokenizers#2111
  • chore: bump pyo3 to version 0.29 by @​SBrandeis in huggingface/tokenizers#2115
  • perf: add benchmarks for the decode API by @​SBrandeis in huggingface/tokenizers#2099
  • ci: cache HF test data and authenticate Hub downloads to avoid rate limits by @​SBrandeis in huggingface/tokenizers#2102
  • Implementing Parity-aware BPE by @​cimeister in huggingface/tokenizers#1974
  • Make doc builds faster by @​mishig25 in huggingface/tokenizers#2158
  • chore(deps-dev): bump websocket-driver from 0.7.4 to 0.7.5 in /tokenizers/examples/unstable_wasm/www by @​dependabot[bot] in huggingface/tokenizers#2208
  • chore(deps-dev): bump shell-quote from 1.8.3 to 1.10.0 in /tokenizers/examples/unstable_wasm/www by @​dependabot[bot] in huggingface/tokenizers#2244
  • chore: remove stale examples (kills 50% of dependabot traffic) by @​ArthurZucker in huggingface/tokenizers#2285
  • chore(node): drop 8 unused devDependencies by @​ArthurZucker in huggingface/tokenizers#2286
  • ci: pin every action to one SHA, drop stale audit suppressions by @​ArthurZucker in huggingface/tokenizers#2291
  • chore(node): take node security alerts from 33 to 0 by @​ArthurZucker in huggingface/tokenizers#2287
  • fix(python): pin the ruff rule set so a ruff release can't redden main by @​ArthurZucker in huggingface/tokenizers#2292
  • Add a ParityBpeTrainer example and list it in the trainers API docs by @​cimeister in huggingface/tokenizers#2217

New Contributors

  • @​eunseo9311 made their first contribution in huggingface/tokenizers#2074
  • @​cimeister made their first contribution in huggingface/tokenizers#1974

Full Changelog: https://github.com/huggingface/tokenizers/compare/v0.23.1...v0.23.2

... (truncated)

Commits
  • 3012770 comment out semver to run rust tests
  • 62c96d3 fix: restore overflowing
  • 580ffcb account for text_signature
  • 14e6dce fix(python): ship submodule stubs as <sub>/init.pyi
  • 935453f chore(python): delete the stale hand-written trainers stub
  • 65903e3 ci: disable rust and node publishing on the 0.23.x branch
  • 2b110f4 ci: remove CI.yml, it publishes to PyPI with a token on every tag
  • ac1dfef ci(python-release): use main's Trusted Publishing release workflow
  • 5ea330f release(python): v0.23.3, allow huggingface_hub <3
  • c2b33f8 update release
  • Additional commits viewable in compare view

PyPI’s official metadata confirms `tokenizers` 0.23.3 was released October 9, 2026, but its own metadata doesn’t state Transformers compatibility. ([pypi.org](https://pypi.org/project/tokenizers/0.23.3/?utm_source=openai))
